plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells a story from the early days of the businessman Elon Musk's rocket ambitions, around the early 2000s. According to Michels, Musk and a space engineer named Mike Griffin travelled to Russia looking for rocket engines, and they actually found them. He tells it as part of the backstory of how private spaceflight got started.
